source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

freedoms.decision: The text does not specify the material of the clamp or the method of tightening.
The text does not specify the exact dimensions of the clamp (other than the desk thickness range).
The text does not specify the type or weight of the monitor arm.
The text does not specify the means by which the clamp attaches to the arm (e.g., VESA interface).

ambiguities.statement: The exact interpretation of 'tight' is ambiguous.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the required clamping force or torque specification is defined.

ambiguities.statement: The phrase 'under the weight of the arm' is ambiguous regarding the magnitude of the weight and the direction of forces.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the weight and force directions are specified.

ambiguities.statement: The requirement 'without any tools' is ambiguous regarding what constitutes a tool.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the definition of tool is specified.

assumptions.statement: The clamp will be used in a typical indoor office environment.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the request specifies outdoor or extreme environments.

assumptions.statement: The monitor arm is a standard commercial product.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the user specifies a custom or unusual arm.
